## Summary

Describe what this pull request adds or corrects and why it belongs in the collection.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched for duplicate titles, DOIs, and resource URLs.
- [ ] Paper titles, venues, and four-digit years match the official source.
- [ ] Papers are placed in every topic where they make a substantial contribution.
- [ ] Each paper appears exactly once in `PAPERS_BY_VENUE.md`.
- [ ] Project, dataset, and tool entries include a concise description.
- [ ] Links use stable official or DOI URLs where available.
- [ ] Markdown and link checks pass.
